citation: Horgan J. et al., QKD Network Characterisation and Coexistence Datasets with Standardised Performance Metrics and Experimental Methods, Zenodo (2026), doi:10.5281/zenodo.21792844 (CC-BY-4.0)
model: XGBoost trained on simulated train split, order-free QBER features only
caveat: Real records are sorted by QBER within each attenuation setting and have no timestamps, so temporal features cannot be computed; a real record's QBER is estimated over a much larger key block than a simulated block.
